title: PointRend: Image Segmentation as Rendering
relevance_note: Adaptive refinement of uncertain segmentation points; motivates sparse selective correction.

title: SegFix: Model-Agnostic Boundary Refinement for Segmentation
relevance_note: Separates unreliable boundaries from reliable interiors; motivates boundary-aware update weights.

title: Object-Contextual Representations for Semantic Segmentation
relevance_note: Soft object-region context and pixel-region relations; motivates probabilistic rather than hard region feedback.

title: Bootstrapping Semantic Segmentation with Regional Contrast
relevance_note: Sparse regional contrast on hard pixels with small memory overhead; candidate second-stage objective.

title: Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation Using Unreliable Pseudo-Labels
relevance_note: Reliable/unreliable pseudo-label separation; supports conservative pseudo-structure supervision.

title: The Lovasz-Softmax Loss: A Tractable Surrogate for the Optimization of the Intersection-over-Union Measure
relevance_note: Direct mIoU surrogate for a future training baseline, not the main innovation.

title: Distributionally Robust Neural Networks for Group Shifts
relevance_note: Event-group robustness candidate after the main module is validated.
